query:
SELECT 
  c.searchId,
  COUNT(c.id) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.enrichmentStatus = 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.briefData IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.salesApproachData IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_approach,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.salesApproachData IS NOT NULL AND c.briefData IS NOT NULL AND c.enrichmentStatus = 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as outreach_ready
FROM companies c
WHERE c.searchId IN (900004, 930001)
GROUP BY c.searchId;
